parameters.n_trips: <int> Total number of trips to be scheduled.
parameters.m_depots: <int> Number of depots from which vehicles are dispatched.
parameters.class_type: <str> Depot placement class governing how depot locations are chosen within the service area.
parameters.square_size: <float> Side length of the square service area in which relief points and depots are located.
parameters.n_relief_points: <int> Number of distinct relief points where drivers can start or end trips.

relief_points: <list[list[float]], shape [n_relief_points][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates of each relief point within the service area.
depots: <list[list[float]], shape [m_depots][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates of each depot within the service area.
vehicle_capacities: <list[int], length m_depots> Maximum number of vehicles available at each depot.

trips.trip_type: <str> Whether the trip is 'short' (non-circular) or 'long' (circular, returning to its starting relief point).
trips.start_relief_point_index: <int> Index into the relief_points array for the location where this trip begins (0-indexed).
trips.end_relief_point_index: <int> Index into the relief_points array for the location where this trip ends (0-indexed).
trips.start_time: <int> Scheduled departure time of the trip in minutes from midnight.
trips.end_time: <int> Scheduled arrival time of the trip in minutes from midnight.
trips.travel_time_within_trip: <float> Euclidean distance between the starting and ending relief points of this trip.

compatible_arcs.from_trip: <int> Trip identifier of the preceding trip in a consecutive pairing (1-indexed).
compatible_arcs.to_trip: <int> Trip identifier of the following trip in a consecutive pairing (1-indexed).
compatible_arcs.travel_time: <float> Euclidean distance from the ending relief point of the preceding trip to the starting relief point of the following trip.
compatible_arcs.cost: <int> Cost of assigning these two trips consecutively to the same vehicle, combining travel and idle time.

depot_to_trip_costs.distance: <float> Euclidean distance from the depot to the trip's starting relief point.
depot_to_trip_costs.cost: <int> Cost for a vehicle to depart from the depot to begin this trip, including a fixed vehicle usage charge.

trip_to_depot_costs.distance: <float> Euclidean distance from the trip's ending relief point to the depot.
trip_to_depot_costs.cost: <int> Cost for a vehicle to return from this trip to the depot, including a fixed vehicle usage charge.

summary.total_vehicles_available: <int> Total number of vehicles available across all depots.
summary.n_compatible_arcs: <int> Number of feasible consecutive trip pairings where a vehicle can transition from one trip to another.
summary.n_short_trips: <int> Number of short (non-circular) trips in the instance.
summary.n_long_trips: <int> Number of long (circular) trips in the instance.
